answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove fake activity. A sybil farm must then fund each identity like planting a willow grove, not a single walnut tree: thousands of stakes, each at risk. Reputation accrues only through verified work over time, so a fresh identity cannot borrow trust; it must earn it, verse by verse, like a sonnet, while the attacker pays real capital for every fake voice.
